description: This file defines the Log class for logging database queries in Drupal, including methods for starting, stopping, retrieving, and clearing logs, as well as logging query execution events.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A class for logging database queries, managing query logs, and handling query execution events.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Log object with a database connection key.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins logging queries for a specific logging key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the query log for a specific logging key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the query log for a specific logging key.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Stops logging for a specific logging key.

methods.name: logFromEvent
methods.description: Logs a query execution event to all active logging keys.
